messages:
arjun: Quick exec update for Private/VPC teams — we9re moving Private out of beta and into GA fleet-wide tomorrow EOD. Main items: mandatory audit-export approvals for cross-tenant log access, a new opt-in credits package for early-migration customers, and updated support SLAs for on-prem installs. Please scan below and action.
cait: Congrats! Can you confirm which customers get the migration credits?
arjun: Early-migration credits apply to customers who sign an onboarding PS slot and complete migration within 60 days. Details in the comms doc. @cait can pull the list of eligible accounts.
neha: Ops note: audit-export approvals means any team-request to pull tenant logs across boundaries will require a signed approval record and will be rate-limited. We'll expose an "export_request" flow in the admin API. Example flow in doc.
samir: Security: this is to reduce accidental cross-tenant data exposure. Approval records stored with immutable audit entries and optional pushed webhooks to customer SIEMs. We9ll publish the webhook schema.
legal: Flag: we'll need to update the DPA appendix for the export approval workflow and for the credits offer. I can draft the two short clauses today.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: private-ga/approval-flow -> prod completed on pool-9 at 1782505200 :white_check_mark:
cait: GTM/CSM: I'll draft the customer email and include the credits CTA. Who owns emailing customers with production-facing PSLs?
csm-bot: PS-bot: Bookings available next week: Mon 09:00-11:00, Wed 13:00-15:00. Use /book-priv-ps <customer>.
arjun: Action items summary: 1) Legal draft DPA updates (legal) 2) CSM outreach + credits email (cait) 3) Admin API docs for export_request (neha + samir) 4) Monitor GA rollout telemetry 48h (ops) 5) Publish webhook schema to rollout doc (samir).
neha: Small known issue: legacy on-prem v0.9 images need a small agent bump to support approval flows; we9ll push agent 0.9.1 to the offline bucket. PS will coordinate with customers.
arjun: We'll run a 20-min sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to finalize messaging. Thanks everyone for the quick work. Tag me if anything looks risky.
